item.title: docpluck: 2 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Summary unavailable.

2 commit(s) today:

  • 711749b [main] docs: CHANGELOG 2.4.162 names all eight new unparsed reasons (df_conflicts_with_header was missing; 'four' corrected after the tag) — Gilad Feldman
  • f9f48c8 [main] fix: an interval beside an untyped column, a merged SE+CI, a detached sign or two intervals in one cell is withheld with a reason; a header df out of domain is named; an empty spacer column is skipped (code review of 2.4.162) — Gilad Feldman
  • 87e20b3 [main] fix: a thousands group never starts with 0 ("0,125" stays untyped), a tight "1,234" df is a pair only beside an F (cross-model review of 2.4.162) — Gilad Feldman
  • 5c84499 [main] fix: publish_pypi.py completes a half-published release, checks the tag, survives a network error while confirming — Gilad Feldman
  • 490e18e [main] release: 2.4.162 - one number reader for every table cell, values stay with their own column and block, out-of-range values withheld with a reason, A4 leaves grouped numbers whole — Gilad Feldman
  • 8aa5413 [main] feat: publish_pypi.py also reads the token from .env when .env.local is absent — Gilad Feldman
  • 88a7040 [main] feat: scripts/publish_pypi.py publishes a tag to PyPI with the token from a gitignored .env.local — Gilad Feldman
  • c37df9f [main] docs: CHANGELOG 2.4.161 names the three linear-pattern speed fixes — Gilad Feldman
  • 4f62ab2 [main] perf: the numeric-word pattern for caption grid bands is linear (a 20,000-digit word took 15 s) — Gilad Feldman
  • dc385ee [main] perf: effect-type header patterns bound their gaps (a 2,000-space header after "eta" took 41 s) — Gilad Feldman
  • 3205e63 [main] perf: the contents-entry pattern starts only at a run's first underscore (40,000 underscores took 90 s) — Gilad Feldman
  • cb3d0c8 [main] docs: the version example names 2.4.161, normalize 1.9.82, tables 2.4.32 — Gilad Feldman
  • 2713a06 [main] fix: a form field is not a table of contents, a bare DOI of any case keeps its number lines, a rebuilt table reads its own column and never ships a neighbour's values — Gilad Feldman
  • 8a6c9e7 [main] release: 2.4.161 - one record per study, own grids, Word files keep their text, blank results flagged — Gilad Feldman
  • 7f5fae2 [main] fix: tables keep leading caption/header rows, search above captions printed under tables, Cohen's h/w are not d, ASCII minus in every table — Gilad Feldman
  • ef7834b [main] perf: the letter-marker scan cache stores on the frozen LayoutDoc — Gilad Feldman
  • 34c295c [main] fix: tables type a column from the label printed above it, label fields typed without a header, keep a packed cell's operator — Gilad Feldman
  • 25a82a0 [main] test: build placeholder ids at run time so the public-repo check passes — Gilad Feldman
  • 3f6e59e [main] test: build the consumer-contract probe PDF on demand — Gilad Feldman
  • 19eabc1 [main] gates: debt trace reads a whole list of ids a commit leaves open — Gilad Feldman
